projects.title: Restore/Restory: An Audio Documentary Project
projects.description:
I served as a Senior Editor for the Restore/Restory project.

Restore/Restory is a community media project that documented the changing cultural, economic, and physical landscape of the lower Cache Creek in rural Yolo County, California. A collaboration between the UC Davis Art of Regional Change and the Cache Creek Conservancy, the project tells the complex story of the Cache Creek Nature Preserve.

The project brings UC Davis students, scholars and artists together with a diverse cross-section of Yolo County residents (tribal leaders, miners, environmental activists, conservancy staff, farmers and ranchers, local historians, policymakers) to tell the story of the Preserve from multiple perspectives. The project produced a multi-author website and an audio tour of the Preserve, featuring multiple voices and experiences at different places on the grounds.  The tour can be taken on site with the use of iPods or experienced via the project website, which also includes archival documents, audio slideshows, maps, interviews and essays—all collaboratively researched, produced and curated by students, residents, scholars, and artists.
